import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 66;
    static int r, c, n;
    static String s;
    static long[][] comb = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] a_count = new int[MAXN], b_count = new int[MAXN];
    static List<Long>[] partials_list = new ArrayList[MAXN], partials_zero_list = new ArrayList[MAXN];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            partials_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partials_zero_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate_combinations() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    static long compute_diff(int conf, int a_prev, int b_prev) {
        long total_diff = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                b_prev++;
                total_diff -= comb[b_prev - 1][r - 1] * (comb[n - b_prev][r] - comb[a_prev][r]);
            } else {
                a_prev++;
                total_diff += comb[a_prev - 1][r - 1] * (comb[n - a_prev][r] - comb[b_prev][r]);
            }
        }
        return total_diff;
    }

    static boolean check_configuration(int conf) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
            char ch = s.charAt(2 * r + c + i);
            if (ch == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (ch == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void process_second_part() {
        int total_conf = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < total_conf; ++conf) {
            int b_cnt = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_cnt = c + 1 - b_cnt;
            if (check_configuration(conf))
                partials_list[a_cnt].add(compute_diff(conf, r + c - a_cnt, r + c - b_cnt));
            else
                partials_zero_list[a_cnt].add(compute_diff(conf, r + c - a_cnt, r + c - b_cnt));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i) {
            Collections.sort(partials_list[i]);
            Collections.sort(partials_zero_list[i]);
        }
    }

    static long count_occurrences(List<Long> data, long val) {
        int low = lowerBound(data, val);
        int up = upperBound(data, val);
        return up - low;
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long val) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= val) high = mid;
            else low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    static int upperBound(List<Long> list, long val) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) > val) high = mid;
            else low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    static class Pair {
        long first, second;
        Pair(long f, long s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }

    static Pair get_coefficient(int conf) {
        // Placeholder: The original code references get_coefficient(conf), but its implementation is missing.
        // Assuming it returns 1 for simplicity.
        return new Pair(1, 1);
    }

    static void update_pair(Pair answer, Pair candidate) {
        if (candidate.first < answer.first || (candidate.first == answer.first && candidate.second > answer.second)) {
            answer.first = candidate.first;
            answer.second = candidate.second;
        }
    }

    static long solve() {
        int total_conf = 1 << (c + 1);
        Pair answer = new Pair(1L << 60, 0);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < total_conf; ++conf) {
            int b_cnt = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_cnt = c + 1 - b_cnt;
            long act = compute_diff(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
            Pair coef_pair = get_coefficient(conf);
            long coef = coef_pair.second;
            int idx = lowerBound(partials_list[c + 1 - a_cnt], -act);
            if (idx != partials_list[c + 1 - a_cnt].size()) {
                long val = partials_list[c + 1 - a_cnt].get(idx);
                if (answer.first >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long count = count_occurrences(partials_list[c + 1 - a_cnt], val);
                    update_pair(answer, new Pair(Math.abs(val + act), coef * count));
                }
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                long val = partials_list[c + 1 - a_cnt].get(idx - 1);
                if (answer.first >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long count = count_occurrences(partials_list[c + 1 - a_cnt], val);
                    update_pair(answer, new Pair(Math.abs(val + act), coef * count));
                }
            }
            long zero_coef = 0;
            int idx_zero = lowerBound(partials_zero_list[c + 1 - a_cnt], -act);
            if (idx_zero != partials_zero_list[c + 1 - a_cnt].size()) {
                long val = partials_zero_list[c + 1 - a_cnt].get(idx_zero);
                long count = count_occurrences(partials_list[c + 1 - a_cnt], val);
                if (answer.first >= Math.abs(val + act))
                    update_pair(answer, new Pair(Math.abs(val + act), zero_coef * count));
            }
            if (idx_zero > 0) {
                long val = partials_zero_list[c + 1 - a_cnt].get(idx_zero - 1);
                long count = count_occurrences(partials_list[c + 1 - a_cnt], val);
                if (answer.first >= Math.abs(val + act))
                    update_pair(answer, new Pair(Math.abs(val + act), zero_coef * count));
            }
        }
        return answer.second;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = br.readLine();
        n = 2 * (r + c);
        generate_combinations();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            a_count[i] = a_count[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i - 1) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            b_count[i] = b_count[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i - 1) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        process_second_part();
        System.out.println(solve());
    }
}
